weapons.name: Night's Edge
weapons.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar
weapons.why: This is the premier pre-Hardmode melee sword and the natural centerpiece of a serious Wall of Flesh prep route.

weapons.name: Sunfury
weapons.why: It is the best pre-Hardmode flail and gives melee a powerful safe-range option in lava-heavy arenas.

weapons.name: Bee Keeper
weapons.why: The bee burst keeps this relevant for boss damage even after stronger raw-stat weapons arrive.

weapons.name: Flamarang
weapons.source: Crafted from an Enchanted Boomerang and Hellstone Bars
weapons.why: It remains the cleanest boomerang option if you are staying on that subclass into late pre-Hardmode.

armor.name: Molten Armor
armor.why: This is the best pre-Hardmode armor period for melee because it combines huge defense with direct damage bonuses.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: It keeps knockback and fire-block hazards from ruining Underworld fights, which is exactly what this phase demands.

accessories.name: Lava Waders
accessories.why: If you can assemble them, they make Wall of Flesh arena setup and Hellstone cleanup dramatically safer.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.source: Combined from Hermes Boots and Rocket Boots
accessories.why: You still want all the mobility you can get for bridge fights and Underworld positioning.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: The dash stays valuable for aggressive melee repositioning throughout pre-Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: This remains the safest default combat potion for late pre-Hardmode melee.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: It makes long boss bridges and Underworld fights more forgiving.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.why: Extra movement speed is still one of the best ways to improve real fight consistency.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction gets better the scarier the fight becomes, and this phase has the scariest pre-Hardmode one.

weapons.name: Molten Fury
weapons.why: This is the bow most players want for Wall of Flesh because it hits hard and works beautifully with strong arrow choices.

weapons.name: Phoenix Blaster
weapons.source: Crafted from the Handgun and Hellstone Bars
weapons.why: It is the cleanest gun answer for the phase if you are not leaning fully into bows or consumables.

weapons.name: Beenades
weapons.source: Crafted from Grenades and Bee Wax
weapons.why: They are famous for a reason: pre-Hardmode Wall of Flesh kills get much easier when you have a healthy stack of these.

weapons.name: Star Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted from the Minishark and Fallen Stars
weapons.why: If you can afford the star ammo, this remains one of the fastest boss-deleting ranged options in the game.

armor.name: Necro Armor
armor.why: This is the clean ranger-specific set for the phase, giving you the offensive stats you actually want for Wall of Flesh.

armor.name: Molten Armor
armor.why: If you value raw defense more than ranged bonuses, Molten is still a respectable fallback.

accessories.name: Magic Quiver
accessories.why: Bow builds feel dramatically better with this, which is why it is the best accessory target for archery-focused ranger setups.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: It solves knockback and fire-block problems at exactly the moment those become most dangerous.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.source: Combined from Hermes Boots and Rocket Boots
accessories.why: Wall of Flesh is much easier when your lateral movement is dependable.

accessories.name: Lava Waders
accessories.why: These remove a lot of the friction and danger from maintaining a clean Underworld bridge.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: It is still the highest-value potion for bow-centric ranger play.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: This keeps your best arrows and bullets alive longer in a phase where boss attempts can chew through supplies.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Defense remains useful because even ranged mistakes get punished hard in the Underworld.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: This stacks nicely with ammo-saving potions and stretches expensive ammunition significantly further.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: This is the mage standout for Wall of Flesh because the piercing scythes can rip through multiple target segments at once.

weapons.name: Water Bolt
weapons.why: It is still excellent for sustained damage and enclosed-space control even after stronger single weapons appear.

weapons.name: Space Gun
weapons.why: Free firing in Meteor Armor keeps this relevant even late into pre-Hardmode progression.

weapons.name: Flower of Fire
weapons.why: The bouncing fireballs give you a versatile alternative if you want something easier to pilot than Demon Scythe.

armor.name: Meteor Armor
armor.why: The Space Gun synergy is still powerful enough to define the phase for many mage runs.

armor.name: Jungle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Jungle Spores, Stingers, and Rich Mahogany
armor.why: It remains the safer alternative if you prefer more traditional mana-stat support.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.source: Crafted from Nature's Gift and a Mana Regeneration Band
accessories.why: It is still the most comfortable and practical mage accessory in long boss attempts.

accessories.name: Celestial Magnet
accessories.why: The bigger star pickup radius helps smooth out mana sustain during hectic movement.

accessories.name: Magic Cuffs
accessories.source: Combined from a Mana Regeneration Band and Shackle
accessories.why: These are still excellent when you expect to take chip damage and want that pain to feed your mana pool.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and fire-block safety are just as useful for fragile mages as they are for every other class.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: The raw magic-damage increase makes this the obvious first buff to maintain.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: It reduces downtime and helps keep your best spells online through the full fight.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: The defense boost still buys much-needed breathing room for a fragile class.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.why: The Clairvoyance station buff is an easy mage-specific bonus if you have the setup time.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.why: This is the best pre-Hardmode summoner minion and the one most players will rely on into Wall of Flesh.

weapons.name: Spinal Tap
weapons.why: Its range and pierce make it the best whip for a pre-Wall of Flesh summoner setup.

weapons.name: Hornet Staff
weapons.why: It remains a very practical alternative if your route reaches full bee progression early.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.why: Even after Spinal Tap appears, this is still a good backup whip and easy recommendation.

armor.name: Obsidian Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Obsidian, evil-biome materials, and Silk
armor.why: It is the top summoner set here because the extra minions and whip bonuses are exactly what this build wants.

armor.name: Bee Armor
armor.why: This is a very respectable alternative if your summoner route leans more toward bee progression.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: The extra minion slot is one of the highest-value accessories in the entire class.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: It protects a fragile class from the exact kind of arena chaos that most often causes bad summoner deaths.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.source: Combined from Hermes Boots and Rocket Boots
accessories.why: Mobility is still non-negotiable because your minions only matter if you stay alive.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.why: Whip speed is still useful because much of your damage routing depends on tag uptime.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: This remains the most important summon-specific buff because the extra minion slot is such a large power increase.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.why: It is another easy minion-slot increase and should be part of any serious boss prep routine.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.why: Summoner still wants every easy stat edge it can get, and this one is almost free.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: The defense gain helps offset the class's usual fragility during longer boss attempts.
